id: \rThat Pokémon of yours. You must trade it to me.
en: \rThat Pokémon of yours. You must trade it to me.
it: \rQuel tuo Pokémon. Devi scambiarlo con me.

id: \rI get it. You are close with your Pokémon.
en: \rI get it. You are close with your Pokémon.
it: \rHo capito. Sei molto legato ai tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bHave you ever seen the different Sawsbuck?
en: \bHave you ever seen the different Sawsbuck?

id: \bSawsbuck change for each season. What if there is a place to see them all together?
en: \bSawsbuck change for each season. What if there is a place to see them all together?
it: \bI Sawsbuck cambiano a ogni stagione. E se ci fosse un posto dove vederli tutti insieme?

id: \bI perform a song called Over the Rainbow.
en: \bI perform a song called Over the Rainbow.
it: \bSuono una canzone che si chiama Over the Rainbow.

id: \bAlder: Hello there. I'm Alder, the Champion of Unova. I'm in a mood for a good battle. Help a guy out, would ya?
en: \bAlder: Hello there. I'm Alder, the Champion of Unova.  I'm in a mood for a good battle. Help a guy out, would ya?
it: \bNardo: Ciao a te. Sono Nardo, il Campione di Unima. Ho proprio voglia di una bella lotta. Dai una mano a un amico, che ne dici?

id: \bAlder: What? Oh yes, the battle. Pretty good kid, even though my Bouffalant did most of the work. I guess you win.
en: \bAlder: What? Oh yes, the battle. Pretty good kid, even though my Bouffalant did most of the work. I guess you win.
it: \bNardo: Cosa? Ah, sì, la lotta. Niente male, ragazzo, anche se il mio Bouffalant ha fatto quasi tutto il lavoro. Direi che hai vinto tu.

id: \bThe bridge is up right now. Go challenge a gym or the Battle Subway to pass the time.
en: \bThe bridge is up right now. Go challenge a gym or the Battle Subway to pass the time.
it: \bIl ponte è alzato al momento. Vai a sfidare una Palestra o il Metrò Lotta per passare il tempo.

id: \bThe bridge is free to cross. Want to go?
en: \bThe bridge is free to cross. Want to go?
it: \bIl ponte si può attraversare. Vuoi andare?
